steps.name: The Sandstorms of Amaloon Desert
steps.objective: Defeat [Desert Nakbas] in the "Amaloon Desert", then report to [Yuran].

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You've arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Iris? Ull showed up and seems to have taken her away... What on earth is going on?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll discuss that with you later. For now, I'll tell you only what you need to know.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris is under our protection, but...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We believe the Alliance bears some responsibility for what her incomplete awakening has caused.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That is why we're dealing with the aftermath of what happened in the Training Forest. We'll discuss Iris later, so please be patient a little longer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How much longer is 'a little'? She's avoiding the subject...)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Not long ago, an enormous sandstorm swept through the Amaloon Desert, west of the Kingdom of Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the problem?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm telling you because it was no ordinary sandstorm. It was filled with magic, and it transformed the Amaloon Desert.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did it change the desert?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The Amaloon Desert was so barren that it was known as the 'Desert of Nothingness.' Nothing could live there.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: People and animals hardly ever ventured near it. Even monsters stayed away.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: But after that magic-laden sandstorm passed through, strange castles and buildings appeared—nothing that could have come from Eastland...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And people and strange creatures emerged from them. Beings from another world...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And... never mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you stop there?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's a minor detail. I don't think it warrants a separate explanation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like there's more to this. I'll have to look into it later.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I'll go take a look.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes. Please hurry.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Yuran stares intently at %s's back as they leave the Lumen Alliance Headquarters.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There were more monsters than I expected.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Now I understand why the guild agents who went to the desert before you, %s, came back as though something were chasing them.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We keep finding ourselves in situations like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That sounded like a pointed remark...)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's the truth.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There's no need to look so surprised. Your expressions are surprisingly easy to read, %s.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Oh, one of the guild agents who returned from the desert has just regained consciousness. I spoke with them.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Apparently, an oasis appeared in the middle of the desert where there had never been one before. They also saw a woman dressed in clothes from another world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person is she?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: They couldn't find out. The monsters that appeared in the desert drove them away. I'm afraid you'll have to investigate that yourself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Of course. I wasn't really expecting much anyway...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The Alliance has a great deal to do as it is. We're helping rebuild the neighboring Kingdom of Jude, dealing with the Deimos cult as it spreads evil...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want me to lend a hand.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Consider this an official request from the Alliance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Understood.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: For safety, I've ordered the Jewel School mages to set up protective barriers on the roads into the Kingdom of Jude and Lumen.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: All you need to do is deal with the situation in the Amaloon Desert, outside the barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do I have to resolve the whole thing on my own?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes. I believe you are the right person for the job, %s. Naturally, someone helping Iris should take on her work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You're not wrong, but isn't that a little much for one person?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If you keep heading west, you'll reach the underground city of Tartaros, but you needn't go that far.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then I'll leave it to you again. Preferably, you'll have everything wrapped up by the time you return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I suppose I have no choice but to go.)

steps.name: Desert Investigation, Part 1
steps.objective: Defeat [Sandstorm Fighters] and [Ra's Guards] in the "Amaloon Desert", then report to [Tia].

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I've been waiting for you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? We've never met...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Please don't be alarmed. I'm not a bad person.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Tia. I am the daughter of the late pharaoh, who ruled the golden castle you see over there.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: You needn't be wary of me. I'm not your enemy. In fact, I want to ask for your help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't sense any hostility, but...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Would this help you trust me? This is something you won't find in your world. Please, take it.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tia places a gold ornament in your hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure you can give this away?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: How about this? If you'll hear me out, I can give you more of whatever you need...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll trust you. So please keep what you were going to give me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You return the gold ornament Tia placed in your hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. The reason I came here is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain to Tia why you've come.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then I'll tell you how I came to be here, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: After my father, the previous pharaoh, passed away, my siblings fought each other for the throne.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: My younger brother and I had neither power nor supporters. We could only pray for those hellish days to end...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: But our older brothers and sisters felt differently. They must have thought us a burden, because they tried to kill us all.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: In the midst of it, my younger brother became disgusted with everyone and did something he should never have done.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: He made a pact with the god of the dead. Consumed by dark power, he killed all our siblings... But he couldn't bring himself to kill me, and gave me time to escape.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The next day, he crowned himself king. I haven't seen him since. If only that were the end of it...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The dark power of the god of the dead began to engulf the kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what happened. Oh, hold on a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to hear more, but... the monsters nearby are getting in the way. I'll deal with them quickly.

steps.name: Desert Investigation, Part 2
steps.objective: Defeat [Priestesses of Terror] in the "Amaloon Desert", then report to [Tia].

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you for your trouble.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we pick up where we left off?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes. After that, I stayed outside the castle, searching for a way to restore my brother and save the kingdom.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm ashamed to say I still haven't found one.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then one day, a violent sandstorm filled with magic suddenly swept over our kingdom...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And that's how you ended up here.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: But coming here created an even greater problem. The darkness that hangs over this continent... an evil more cruel than anything I've ever known...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: It's entering the castle, trying to create something even greater... Please help us...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The darkness on this continent... Now that you mention it, I think I can feel it. There's an ominous presence here...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: You may learn something by examining the monsters nearby.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I find anything, could you take a look? I don't know anything about the place you came from.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Of course. Thank you. Please take care of yourself.

steps.name: Reporting the Situation
steps.objective: Talk to Tia in the "Amaloon Desert", then report to [Yuran] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters".

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: You're back, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Tia about fighting the creatures that came here with the desert kingdom of Ra.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: It seems the power of the god of the dead and the dark power flowing through this continent have strengthened one another.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they're affecting each other...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: They are probably similar kinds of power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is this god of the dead?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The being that corrupted my younger brother with dark power. It is more a demon than a god.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: In the desert kingdom of Ra, we believe that when a person dies, their soul leaves their body and wanders in search of a place to go.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Someone takes those souls to the world of the dead so they won't suffer. That is the god of the dead.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: A guide who keeps human souls from losing their way and helps them find rest...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then why do you call him a demon instead of a god?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: One day, a being calling itself the 'god of the dead' appeared. From then on, an aura of death lingered in the castle.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The golden castle gradually lost its luster, and people began to die. So the pharaoh sought out that being, fought it, and won.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: He sealed it inside a guardian statue and executed the one who had summoned it, so that demon would never appear again...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: But my younger brother summoned the imprisoned god of the dead and made a pact with it. Everything took a turn for the worse.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The god of the dead accomplished its goal and vanished for a time... But what happened afterward was the problem. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer, I think you should report this. Judging by the magic of the place where you were staying, they should be able to prepare for it to some extent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm counting on you...

steps.name: An Insect Monster from Another World
steps.objective: Defeat [Raunatun] in "Ra's Fortress", then report to [Tia] in the <Amaloon Desert>.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Since you've come to me, I assume you've learned something serious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Yuran about meeting Tia in the Amaloon Desert.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I have a fair understanding of the situation now. What a headache. It seems you'll need to start where their defenses are weakest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where would that be?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hmm, a place called Ra's Fortress... By the way, adventurer, do you like insects?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Insects?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Apparently, there's an enormous insect monster there. It's devouring everything in sight. At this rate, it may break out.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Even several guild members together don't seem strong enough to handle it.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm afraid you'll have to deal with it yourself. We won't be able to move against the other areas until you do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll put up with this for Iris's sake, but...)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll take that as your agreement. Work with that woman from the other world and resolve this as quickly as possible. And don't worry about Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. We'll talk later.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Yuran stares intently at %s's back as they leave Lumen.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: This won't do after all. Something similar must have happened elsewhere, not just in the Amaloon Desert. I'll have to keep investigating.

steps.name: The King Who Bargained with the God of the Dead
steps.objective: Defeat [Mautu] in the "Hall of Rest", then report to [Tia] in the <Amaloon Desert>.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you. With Raunatun defeated, some of the god of the dead's darkness has vanished from the fortress.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It does feel like some of that foul presence has left the desert.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The people of Ra had feared Raunatun for ages. Its appetite was so great that it swallowed people and animals whole.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: As though that weren't enough, it often came down to attack people's homes. The first pharaoh was deeply troubled by it. He tried to destroy Raunatun, but couldn't finish it off.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: So they offered the most heinous criminals to its nest, appeasing its hunger, if only for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a good reason to stay out of trouble. To have your life end inside an insect... It's horrifying just to think about.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer... There's just one thing left to do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you be all right with this?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: My younger brother is no longer the kind, innocent person he once was. Darkness has consumed him. He's become a monster obsessed with power and destruction.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Please don't think of Mautu as my brother. Think of him as a monster threatening this world. I beg you.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tia turns her head away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me ask you one more time. Are you sure you'll be all right?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes. I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then... I'll go.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Now that you've returned, adventurer, it must be over.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tia, are you all right...?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, I'm all right. I believe my brother would have recognized what he'd done wrong. Thank you... for freeing him from the darkness.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I no longer feel any darkness in the Amaloon Desert. It's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I intend to go home. I'm the only member of the royal family the people of Ra have left. I must be there for them.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm ashamed that I'm such a powerless princess, with nothing to offer you but words...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: But I don't know how to get back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. You came on a sandstorm, so perhaps you can ride one back?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: That does seem the most likely way.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Wouldn't a skilled mage know what to do? Surely someone understands the sandstorm that brought us here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're right! The mages in Lumen investigated that sandstorm. They might know something! I'll go ask them!

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then please do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be right back. Stay here and wait for me.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hello! You seem to be in a hurry. Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain what happened in the Amaloon Desert and ask about the enormous sandstorm.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The sandstorm in the Amaloon Desert... Oh dear. What should we do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why? Has something gone wrong?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Nothing's gone wrong exactly, but I don't think another sandstorm will appear in the desert for some time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Why not?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Well, the truth is... the dark power from another world, Iris's incomplete awakening, the sinister power of this continent, and so on...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That magic-laden sandstorm was a phenomenon caused by all those things coming together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just to be sure... Did Iris's incomplete awakening affect another world, too?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes. Even if the effect wasn't very large, I think it did have some influence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what being a god means...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: About the sandstorm... Now that you've destroyed the dark power from the other world, things are rather complicated.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The sandstorm can't form anymore. No one is blocking it; it seems the phenomenon itself has come to an end.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: If Iris becomes a great god, I'm sure she could sort it out in no time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So Iris is our only answer...

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I think this would be difficult even for an Champion, or for Ixion, the heroic archmage who defended the Kingdom of Jude during the Dark War long ago.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Even if all our best jewelers worked on the finest magic gems, they couldn't produce that much power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If even an Champion couldn't do it, then who...? Sigh... Where is this Ixion now, anyway?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: He lived several hundred years ago, so I imagine he's in a better place now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Then there's nothing we can do. We'll just have to trust Iris and wait. It's not as if I can blame her for this.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes, exactly. By the way, %s, have you ever lost your memory, even for a very short time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? No. That's never happened to me... Why?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I've seen someone who lost some of their memories because of magic. Sometimes your expression reminds me of theirs, %s. If I'm mistaken, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must be imagining it. I'm fine. I'll let the princess from the other world know what you said.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: All right. See you later.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: You're back! Did they say what we should do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Tia what Asma said.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, I see. The god you serve is in an unstable state.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I think you'll have to stay here for a while... Will that be all right?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, I'll be fine. You've assured me that I can return someday. That's enough for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The god you serve sounds like a very kind person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm? What do you mean? Iris? Would 'kind' be the right word? Hmm...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Iris. What a beautiful name. Hehe. Whatever you say, I can tell how much you care about her.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm grateful to her for letting me meet someone as good as you...

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: From now on, I'll look after this place and make sure it causes no harm to the neighboring kingdoms or villages. I'll fulfill my responsibilities as a member of Ra's royal family to the very end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll come visit you from time to time, Tia.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then travel safely. We'll meet again.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tia sees %s off, watching until they disappear from sight.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: What is this ominous feeling...?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Could there be a being like the god of the dead in this world, too? One that has no choice but to do such things...?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You have good instincts, princess. I'm not a god of death or anything, but perhaps there's a bit of a resemblance.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Wait, you... Where did you come from...?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hey, princess? No need to tremble or be afraid. I'm not going to hurt you.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: There's simply something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Do you happen to know anything about '▒▒▒▒'?
